task.title: Creating an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) for the IPOC transactions

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the Integrity registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select D - No .
Detection: This field is prefilled based on the investigation type as displayed in NIIS.
Infraction: Select F - Non-fraud - Other .
Message: Select 27 - An overpayment resulted due to an incorrect calculation .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the Integrity registration number.
BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 54 - Third party fraud .
Remarks line 1: Type “Tiger team. Fraudulent claim. Unknown third party.”
Remarks line 2: Type “Void the claim. Adjust tax file, if necessary.”

Remarks line 3: Type the appropriate option:
“No payment issued.”
“Remove w/cs [XXXX] to [XXXX] from client’s file.”
If payments have been returned or were never redeemed, type: “Cancel returned payments for w/cs [XXXX] to [XXXX]. T071-2 [for current year] or T071-8 [for previous year] / reason F / CT [XX].” For each payment, type “w/c [XXXX] / gross amount [XXXX] / federal tax [XX] / provincial tax (if necessary) [XX] / net amount [XXXX] / payment reference number [XXXXXXXXXXXX].”
Remarks line 4: Type “Create an REM WI for Level 1 to establish BPC [w/c] with application dated [YY-MM-DD]”.
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes .

step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity file number] — Fraudulent EI Claim.”

Details: Do the following:
Type: “The investigator confirmed the client’s address on [date]. The client’s address is: [client’s address].”
Document the decision and rationale according to the Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: Create ROD on the fraudulent EI application as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity file number] — EI application submitted by a third party.”

Details: Enter the following information:
Relevant facts: Type “An EI application was filed by a third party on [date] using the client’s identity.”
Decision/Justification: Type “This application was not filed by the client and must not be included in an access to information request.”

step.cmd: To delete the fraudulent application, create a REM WI as follows:

ul.li: Complexity: Select Level 1 .
Reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Delete the application.”
Due date: Enter the next working day.
Language: Select the appropriate option.
Details: Type “Fraudulent claim.”
Destination — SCC: Enter the SCC as shown in FTS.

End user: Select Specific user:
Enter the name of the team leader or the designated person and select Find user .
Select Save .

step.cmd: In NIIS, on the Decision tab of the Report of Investigation (IC70) , close the case as follows:

ul.li:
Disentitlement: Select No .
Reason: Select Other and type “Fraudulent claim. Third-party OP amount is $[XX].”
Overpayment: Do not check the box.
Penalty: Select No .
Warning: Select No .
Violation: Select No .
Prosecution: Select No .
Select OK .

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the CR Integrity WI.
